api: topologies.training.losses:get_loss('lwf')(logits_or_prediction, targets, *, ignore_index=None, reduction='mean', old_logits, old_probabilities, temperature=2.0, lambda_old=1.0)
description: Implements Li & Hoiem, Sec. III, Fig. 3 and Eqs. (1)-(4): new-task class-index cross entropy plus lambda_old times the summed temperature-softened old-task distillation cross entropies. Cached old-model probabilities and current old-task logits are supplied by the caller. The structured-objective recipe binds named model outputs and batch fields (src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:36-48).

examples.title: Train new and old task heads with LwF

name: Learning without Forgetting composite loss

parameters.ignore_index: optional integer class-index sentinel; ignored samples contribute zero to both new and old-task terms
parameters.lambda_old: finite nonnegative real weight for the sum of old-task distillation losses (default 1.0)
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point new-task logits with shape [B, C_new]
parameters.old_logits: current old-task logits with shape [B, C_old], or a nonempty sequence of such tensors for multiple tasks
parameters.old_probabilities: cached old-model probability rows matching old_logits; tensor for one task or a matching sequence for multiple tasks
parameters.reduction: none per sample, mean over nonignored samples, or sum (default mean)
parameters.temperature: finite positive probability-softening temperature for old-task distillation (default 2.0)
